clue.text: Dreams of flying rooks

parts.note: in chess a rook is also called a castle, here in the plural
something flying is up in the sky, aloft

explanation.surface: A fantasy about rooks taking wing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rooks' suggests birds, which suits 'flying', but the chess sense is the one used.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: grand imaginary schemes that will never be realised are daydreams.

clue.text: TV personality girl needs weight reduced at first

parts.note: Ann is a common girl's name
an ounce is a small imperial weight

indicators.note: signals taking only the opening letter of the word reduced

explanation.surface: A television presenter who has to slim down.
explanation.definitionFit: A broadcaster who introduces programmes or reads links on air is a familiar TV figure.

clue.text: Four in six days can be very bright

indicators.note: signals the Roman four going inside the six-plus-days pair

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Four days within a six-day stretch can be brilliantly sunny.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: vivid colours or light are intensely bright.

clue.text: Agents holding the origin of curry?

definitions.text: Agents holding the origin of curry?

indicators.note: the agents keep the next letter within them, a containment

parts.note: secret agents are spies

indicators.note: the origin of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Spies smuggling the source of a curry.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: the seasonings are indeed where a curry starts.
explanation.definitionFit: Seasonings such as cumin and turmeric are the basis from which a curry is made.

clue.text: Daily lives, initially mundane, acquire alluring quality

parts.note: a daily, or char, is a British cleaning lady who comes in each day
lives means is, exists

indicators.note: takes the opening letters of the two words that follow

explanation.surface: A cleaner's ordinary life gains glamour.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'daily' or 'char' is old British slang for a cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: personal magnetism that attracts others is an alluring quality.

clue.text: Strong man takes identical strain endlessly

indicators.note: both words lose their final letters, so each runs without an end

parts.note: identical means the same
a strain is a tune or song

explanation.surface: A strongman exerting himself with the same strain over and over.
explanation.definitionFit: Biblical figure: the hero of the Book of Judges was famed for great physical strength.

clue.text: What could turn into a bore

definitions.text: What could turn into a bore

parts.words: What could turn into a bore
parts.note: read not as something becoming tedious but as a tool that spins its way into a hole

explanation.definitionFit: A cutting tip fitted to a power tool rotates to make a bored hole.

clue.text: In prison, a favourite one of some French royals

indicators.note: the following pieces sit inside the word for prison

parts.note: the can is slang for prison
a pet is a favourite
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A favourite inmate of a jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective for the dynasty founded by Hugh Capet that ruled France from 987.

clue.text: Get ready to play melody at a higher level

parts.note: a melody is a tune
up means at a higher level

explanation.surface: A musician raises the pitch of a melody.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal verb: musicians warm up or check pitch before a performance.

clue.text: Get rid of wicked and spiteful woman

parts.note: to shed is to get rid of
wicked means evil

explanation.surface: An instruction to rid oneself of wickedness.
explanation.definitionFit: Insult: a malicious, cruel woman is called a female demon.

clue.text: American fuel needing reprocessing to be profitable

indicators.note: the letters of fuel must be processed again into a new order

explanation.surface: American fuel has to be refined before it pays.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something profitable is of use or benefit.

clue.text: Change commercial featuring males

indicators.note: the advert includes the males within it

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
males are men

explanation.surface: Altering a TV advert that stars men.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to revise or alter a text is to change it.

clue.text: Free, like the melody in popular song

definitions.text: like the melody in popular song
definitions.meaning: the 1955 hit sung by the Righteous Brothers is titled with this word followed by Melody

explanation.surface: Liberated, like the tune of a famous song.
explanation.definitionFit: Released from shackles means set free; the word also titles the famous Melody.

clue.text: Unfortunate fat redefinition leads to discriminatory action

indicators.note: an unfortunate arrangement of the letters signals reshuffling them

explanation.surface: A clumsy redefinition of fat leads to prejudice.
explanation.definitionFit: Noun: treating groups unequally is to discriminate, distinguishing between them.

clue.text: A lot of help needed to support church basic structure

indicators.note: in a down clue the support goes below, so this piece comes after the church
a lot of a word means most of it, here dropping the last letter

parts.note: to assist is to help

explanation.surface: A church in need of plenty of help.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the frame of a vehicle on which the body is built is its base structure.

clue.text: Egyptian location of scenes in Aida

indicators.note: the location is taken from, made of, the letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Where Verdi's Egyptian opera is set.
explanation.walkthrough: Aida is Verdi's opera set in Egypt, so the surface fits.
explanation.definitionFit: Geography: the peninsula and mountain lie in north-east Egypt.

clue.text: Herbaceous plant round us, held by lifting tool for gardeners

indicators.note: the round thing and us are kept inside the reversed tool
in a down clue, lifting means writing the word upwards, backwards

parts.note: a trowel is a small gardening tool
a round shape is the letter O

explanation.surface: A gardener lifting a plant with a trowel.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanical: a meadow plant once thought to give livestock lice.

clue.text: Hit hard out of fright

indicators.note: the letter for hard is taken out of the word for fright

parts.note: a shock is a fright
H stands for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Lashing out from fear.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang verb: to punch someone forcefully, strike with the fist.

clue.text: The Royal Navy's after number right at the top of their charts?

definitions.text: at the top of their charts?

indicators.note: the navy part comes after the number and right

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy, the 's being is

explanation.surface: Sailors topping the music charts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charts' suggests music hit lists, but these are maps, where north is at the top.
explanation.definitionFit: On maps north is at the top, so what is up there is in the north.

clue.text: Stay near Sussex resort on river

parts.note: Hove is a seaside town beside Brighton in Sussex, on England's south coast

explanation.surface: Lingering in a seaside town by the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb: to linger close by something, remaining poised nearby.

clue.text: A handicap about five is to be recommended

indicators.note: the handicap goes around the five

parts.note: to disable is to handicap
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: A golfer with a handicap of about five is to be recommended.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: advisable courses are wise ones that can be recommended.

clue.text: Change outline of warning light on boat

parts.note: a red light warns of danger
a raft is a simple boat

explanation.surface: A danger light shown on a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb: to write a draft again, altering its outline.

clue.text: What looks like plane flying across Canada?

definitions.text: What looks like plane flying across Canada?

parts.words: What looks like plane flying across Canada?
parts.note: read not as an aircraft but as the leaf of a plane tree, whose look-alike flies on the Canadian flag

explanation.definitionFit: The national emblem on Canada's flag closely resembles a plane tree's leaf.

clue.text: State of girl embracing boy

indicators.note: the girl holds the boy within her name

parts.note: Louisa is a girl's name
Ian is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A girl hugging a boy.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: one of the fifty US states, on the Gulf of Mexico.

clue.text: Liberality seen the world over

definitions.meaning: the lines of this measure run around the whole globe

explanation.definitionFit: Means leeway or freedom; also angular distance from the equator, marked across every map.

clue.text: Sat stirring in basis for cheese sauce

indicators.note: the stirred letters go inside the basis for cheese

parts.note: cheese is made from curd

indicators.note: stirring mixes the letters of sat

explanation.surface: Sitting and stirring the base of a cheese sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a sweet pouring sauce made with milk and eggs.

clue.text: Knight finding youth beset by torture

indicators.note: the youth is surrounded by the torture

parts.note: pain is torture
a lad is a youth

explanation.surface: A knight finding a young man being tortured.
explanation.definitionFit: Historical: one of Charlemagne's twelve peers, a chivalrous knight.

clue.text: Key name awaited to invest

parts.note: E is a musical key
something due is expected, awaited

explanation.surface: A key name awaited at an investment.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb: to endow or furnish someone with a quality, invest them with it.

clue.text: Magic mushrooms perhaps amusing serviceman

parts.note: fun means amusing
a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier finding magic mushrooms entertaining.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: mushrooms, magic or otherwise, belong to this kingdom of organisms.

clue.text: Tax small rural dwelling

parts.note: a cot is an archaic word for a cottage

explanation.surface: Levy on a little country cottage.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic word for a levy, as in scot-free, meaning untaxed.
